rule: PCGen rule (pinned 7f81800, verified in source on this box): value(V) for character C = [largest DEFINE seed among objects C HOLDS -- always 0 here] + SUM over every object C holds of each BONUS:VAR|V|f whose own PRE passes (PlayerCharacter.getVariable -> variableFacet + getTotalBonusTo("VAR") -> BonusManager.sumActiveBonusMap); if no held object DEFINEs V the name is not a variable: PCGen tries the builtin terms, then the export tokens, then the broken parser -> 0, and the BONUS:VAR contributions are DROPPED (includeBonus=false path). Converter rule: V is the sum of contributions from HELD rules. Expr has no 'held' term, so the converter has exactly two mechanical choices. (A) INLINE: replace V by Sum over every contributor record r of Held(r.id, f_r) -- needs an Expr::Held(RuleId, Box<Expr>) variant (contributes f_r only if the character holds rule r, else 0) or an equivalent Applies-gated sub-expression; correct, no variable names survive, but AC_Natural_Armor inlines 1,545 terms into every consumer. (B) VAR TABLE: Expr::Var(VarId) with VarId an opaque converter-minted id (no PCGen name), and a converter-emitted data/sheet_rules/_vars/<id>.json listing (rule_id -> Expr) contributions; the live evaluator sums the contributions of held rules. (B) is PCGen's own mechanism restated in our schema, is the only form that stays small, and is what the bonus lane's 'producer chain inlined' (their rule 2) needs in order to be CORRECT -- unconditional inlining sums contributions from records the character does not hold (BloodlineLVL has 6 contributors: Blood Arcanist, Eldritch Scion, Bloodline Development ...; only one is ever held). Either way the DEFINE-existence gate is dropped: every seed is 0, so gating on 'some held object DEFINEs V' changes nothing except to drop bonuses PCGen would drop -- see row 30 for the names PCGen drops.
